posts.meta_description:
576K likes, 1,256 comments - jasminbhasin2806 on September 21, 2026: "Last night, my journey on KKK 15 came to an end. ❤️

Not one of my best journeys, but definitely one that I’m proud of. Proud because despite everything, I kept trying. Even after that terrifying memory-loss experience, when fear completely took over me, I still showed up and tried every single time.

Some injuries can’t be seen. Some fears can’t really be explained. They can only be felt and experienced. And for me, this was one of those battles. Fear took over at times, but I kept pushing myself, and that’s something I’ll always be proud of.

I honestly don’t think I could have gotten through this journey without the best host and an even better human, Rohit Sir, my darling co-contestants who stood by me, and the entire @colorstv and Khatron team for constantly understanding and supporting me through what I was going through. ❤️

Thank you to everyone who loved me, supported me, stood by me and understood my conflicts, even when I couldn’t always explain them.

And Harsh… tu panauti nahi hai, tu sabse pyaara hai yaar! 😂❤️ It was the comfort and the bond we shared that allowed us to have the most ridiculous, endless fights, and somehow your support always gave me strength. I’m going to miss that.

So, alvida to my favourite show and one of the best reality shows ever. ❤️
KKK 15, you were a tough one, but I’ll always carry this journey with me.".

posts.meta_description:
165K likes, 1,028 comments - jasminbhasin2806 on September 19, 2026: "@itsrohitshetty Sir, you are truly the POOKIEST 🥹😭❤️

You’ve always been the person pushing me to face my fears and reminding me that I’m stronger than I think I am. But this time, you literally took the shocks for me 😭 That moment honestly touched my heart in a way I can’t explain.

This is my third season of KKK, and through all these years, you’ve always known when to push me, when to encourage me and, most importantly, when to simply have my back. You’ve made me feel supported and safe, even while pushing me to do things I never thought I could. And that means a lot to me. 🫶🏻

I’m sure every khiladi who has been in Khatron over the years will agree that you’re surely our guiding light ❤️".
